name: Mercado Beira-Rio
description: Across the river, this bustling food hall is a haven for food and wine lovers. Sample authentic Portuguese dishes and enjoy a glass of Port with beautiful city views.
longDescription:
The Mercado Beira-Rio is a three-day food market event held annually, focusing on local and regional Portuguese culinary offerings. It brings together various vendors, showcasing a range of prepared dishes, fresh produce, and beverages. The market aims to highlight the gastronomic diversity of the region, providing a platform for producers and chefs to present their specialities.

Visitors to the Mercado Beira-Rio can expect an informal atmosphere, with multiple food stalls and communal seating areas. The event is suitable for individuals and groups interested in sampling different Portuguese foods and wines. Located in Vila Nova de Gaia, the market offers views across the Douro River towards the city of Porto.

Entry to the Mercado Beira-Rio is free. The venue in Vila Nova de Gaia is accessible via a short walk from the Jardim do Morro metro station, which is one stop from Porto's São Bento station. The market is family-friendly.
